command.name: Cleansing Wrath
verbatim: Each Round: Cleanse up to 3 Positive effects from enemies. Each instance has a separate 20% chance and selects 1 Enemy in any lane.
Rounds 3, 6, 9: Deal Fire Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +190%).

At 6+ Stars: Each Round: When you Cleanse an enemy, afflict the target with 1 stack of Infectious Wrath (Max 3 stacks) for 3 rounds. Rounds 3, 6, 9: Deal Physical Damage to 2 Enemies within adjacency (Damage Rate: +30%), doubled if the target is afflicted with Panic.

vanguard.name: Champion's Brilliance
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Strength, Intelligence, and Instinct by +15. Reduce Damage Received by -8% of the Ally deployed in the Right Flank.

habits.name: Clever Maneuver
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Intelligence and Initiative of the Ally with the highest Intelligence until the end of combat. Both effects are enhanced by Instinct.

habits.name: Wind's Favor
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Initiative (enhanced by Initiative) of 3 Allies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Infectious Wrath
habits.verbatim: Cleansing Wrath gains Infectious Wrath. Each stack reduces the target's Recovery Received; its Physical Damage is doubled against Panic.

habits.name: Cunning Ferocity
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Intelligence of 2 adjacent Allies and their Fire Damage Dealt until the end of combat.

habits.name: Loyal Bond
habits.verbatim: Each Round: chance to grant Advantage to 2 other Allies above 50% troop capacity or Resistance to 2 other Allies below 50% troop capacity for 2 rounds.
